build_command: In ../UniXNU, set UNIXNU_UEFI, T970_DEVICE_DIR, T970_QCA_BLUETOOTH_DIR, T970_ATH12K_WIFI_DIR and T970_GPU_ADDON to the same inputs as main7; run python3.14 ./unixnu build kernel -D ../UniXNU-sm-t970 --local-module AppleKeyStoreState=../UniXNU-sm-t970/.cache/AppleKeyStoreState-8c70daf.
implementation: native_t970_cadence splits the direct path into the previous confirmed CTL latch to the next flip (gap) and that flip to CTL flush confirmation (ack).
The first frame, idle gaps over 100 ms and unconfirmed 50 ms CTL timeouts are separate. Static desktop time is not counted as a slow produced frame.
BootProgress publishes lifetime CADENCE means and maxima and two-second delta rows through the paired USB syslog path. Existing PHASE copy/presenter counters are unchanged.
scripts/analyze-t970-cadence.py weights the delta rows by sample count, reports threshold rates and emits a conservative routing hint only after 30 gap and 30 confirmed ACK samples.
verification: The actual accounting methods pass ASan/UBSan for first frame, active gap, slow gap, slow ack, idle exclusion and timeout reset. Existing fence and display tests pass.
The full 21H461 kernel archive, ABI audit, link and prelink passed. The packed kernel exports native_t970_cadence and native_t970_scanout_latches and contains both CADENCE log formats.

Readback verified the exact main7 addon, owner trust, ADT, Data seed, Samsung wrapper and 994-byte command line. The only baseline configuration replacement remains armcpu-self-ipi=1 to dpu-scanout=2.

The cadence analyzer passes weighted-gap, ACK-timeout, malformed-row and insufficient-sample regression cases. Running it on the pre-cadence main7 log finds 91 scanout rows and correctly refuses to invent cadence samples.
expected_device_result: During the same desktop swipe workload, gap_mean_us plus ack_mean_us should account for the measured latch interval. gap over 20 ms selects the Metal/Turnip/submission branch; ack over 3 ms selects the CTL flush/latch branch.
limits: The 58-second capture establishes the direct-scanout cadence split for this workload, not universal frame rate or a safe early-retire policy. ACK includes the physical refresh wait. The gap still combines compositor swap arrival with post-arrival fence, mapping and work-loop time; cadence-b separates those before an optimization is selected.
